fields.Name: T194 - Admin Class Registry Inspector
fields.Description: Opens the Admin app's Developer Tools section and navigates to the Class Registry sub-section. Verifies the class registry inspector renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) - the pinned app list is short and Admin is visible without scrolling. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'Class Registry' sub-section. The success state is the class registry inspector rendered, showing a list/tree of registered classes (and typically search or detail controls) OR a valid empty-state. This is a developer tool view, so accept an empty-state as long as the inspector chrome renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for the inspector to render rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin application is active and the Developer Tools section is open
The Class Registry sub-section is selected and the inspector renders a list/tree of classes or a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
